text: Implemented on local main 3f44b1d: geomRasterByClass(classOf, Vector[ColorClass]) over a ClassedColorScaleSpec fill scale (per-class training/mapping, one image); derived guides emit one colorbar per class. Evidence: ClassedRasterSuite 6/6 JVM+JS: each class reaches both its palette endpoints independent of the other class's domain, grey class stays grey; per-class colorbars == ordinary geomRaster colorbar of that class alone (colors and ticks); empty class -> no bar; mask/unknown class -> missingColor; determinism. classed-raster conformance case passes svg/canvas/java2d(PNG)/pdf/javafx harnesses (device-scene image identical by construction); per-pixel cross-backend comparison of the PNG/JavaFX output not done.
